submission.reason: Exploration of data/explore.csv showed soil_ph was the only candidate with a notable signal: largest raw correlation with yield (0.339), strongly confounded with farm (farm-level soil_ph means aligned perfectly with farm-level yield means), and the largest within-farm effect (coef ~0.23, p~0.10) among all ten exposures. I locked soil_ph as the single hypothesis and ran the pre-registered confirmatory OLS of yield_kg on soil_ph plus farm indicators on held-out data. The effect did not replicate: estimate 0.104 (SE 0.123), t=0.84, p=0.40, n=396, not significant at alpha=0.05. Therefore no exposure is confirmed to have a direct effect on yield_kg after accounting for farm.
